title: Invoices
notes: All four pages rebuilt on ListPage/DetailPage/EntityForm archetypes. detailDrawer is intentionally false — list rows navigate to the full detail route (onRowClick) rather than opening a drawer, matching the leads/contacts precedent, since invoices need the full tabbed detail page. themedExport reuses the existing bulk-PDF-zip endpoint (no dedicated invoices Excel/CSV export exists) applied to selected or loaded rows. PDF still lacks branded header/QR/bank details/amount-in-words (#41) and detail still has no separate GST breakdown section beyond the existing CGST/SGST/IGST line items in Totals (#36) — both are backend/design assets outside this slice's file allowlist. phoneInput/addressAutocomplete are not applicable — invoices slice has no phone or address fields.
showcaseScript: Open Invoices and filter to overdue
Create a GST invoice from an itinerary
Show the tax breakdown and branded PDF preview
Email the invoice through the Communication Hub
